newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH PLOCK REFINERY UPS PERTOL PRICE ON AUG 11.
newsitem.headline: POLISH PLOCK REFINERY UPS PERTOL PRICE ON AUG 11.

text.p: Poland's largest oil refinery, Petrochemia Plock, said on Friday it will increase its petrol price from Monday by 20 zlotys a tonne after the smaller Gdansk refienry announced a 30-zloty-a-tonne rise as off that day.
"Petrochemia will increase wholesale prices of petrols by 20 zlotys a tonne as off Monday. The price of diesel will not change," the company spokeswoman Romana Kuffel told Reuters.
The rise could translate into an increase of retail petrol price by about 0.02 zloty per litre.
Kuffel said the increase, already third since July, resulted from high world oil prices and the increasingly strong U.S. dollar.
Earlier in the day, the Gdansk refinery, said it would lift its petrol and diesel fuel price by 30 zlotys a tonne as of Monday after Wednesday's increase by 20 zlotys a tonne.
Since July Gdansk and Plock, which supply 80 percent of the Polish market, increased prices by between 0.02 and 0.05 zloty a litre, depending on petrol brand.
Analysts said the increases of the wholesale prices had not been reflected in retail prices growth. But the price could strat growing next week.
Poland's petrol prices has grown by between five and 13 percent since the government liberalised them in February.
